about_short_description.short_description: Tributi is a Colombian fintech start-up backed by Y Combinator.

product.name: Tax Declaration for Natural Persons 2025
product.description: A digital service that helps individuals in Colombia prepare and submit their annual income tax declaration to the DIAN, ensuring compliance with local tax laws.

product.name: Tributi App
product.description: A cloud-based application that guides users step-by-step to complete their tax declaration, import data from DIAN, and submit it electronically with expert support available.

product.name: Expert Tax Declaration Service
product.description: A service where a tax expert prepares, reviews, and submits the user's income tax declaration, providing personalized assistance via WhatsApp or video call.

product.name: Corporate Employee Tax Declaration Package
product.description: A package designed for companies to provide their employees with access to Tributi's tax declaration services, including communication support and error liability coverage.

identifier.value: Tax Obligation and Residency Fiscal Status Tools

product.name: Tax Obligation and Residency Fiscal Status Tools
product.description: Online tools that help users determine if they must file income tax and assess their fiscal residency status in Colombia.
